what: Import of the 250 curated_question Problem drafts from the morphoswarm open-problems register into the live delphi-frontier node, as PROPOSED records.
importer_commit_note: scripts/import_register.py and scripts/submit_drafts.py as committed at ae1eca5 (HEAD at the time of the write may be later: only docs/receipt were added after)
drafts_generated_by: python3 -I scripts/import_register.py <register.yaml> --assessments findings --out drafts.jsonl  (250 importable, 0 rejected, 0 actionable, quote_review: 15 sample_checked / 450 unreviewed)

submitted_by.credential: read in process from a mode-600 file; never printed or recorded

node.dsn: unix socket host=/data/services/delphi-frontier/run port=5471 dbname=frontier user=frontier_app

result.read_back_how: Store.get without a credential (the public read path), in the importing process, for each of the 250 versions: is_head and local status proposed. Not an HTTP request.

idempotent_rerun.note: a read-only re-plan after the write found all 250 unchanged, so a re-run writes nothing and makes no new version

not_claimed: Records are proposed, not accepted or reviewed. completeness is recorded for all 250; none is actionable. Quotes are the curator's transcriptions: 450 of 465 are unreviewed and 15 carry the sample assessments, which is not an error rate for the register.
